请求协助整理思路: Ask for Help Sorting Out Ideas
我要找到能被反驳和复查的解释，让别人的选择有真实依据。: I want explanations that can be challenged and checked, so people have solid grounds for their choices.
我要握住自己的工具和答应别人的权利；愿意帮忙，不等于谁能替我一直答应。: I want to keep my tools and the right to decide what I promise. Being willing to help does not give anyone the right to keep promising on my behalf.
别人可以笑我的诗，不能因为雀儿没有家世，就把她的同意也一并收走。: People can laugh at my verse. They cannot take away Quer’s right to consent just because she has no family standing.
我要试出他人真正肯守的边界，争取判断上的先手；路被堵住，就借堵路的人留下的新条件: I want to find out which boundaries people will actually defend and stay one step ahead in judging them. When a path is blocked, I will use the openings left by whoever blocked it.
我要让伤员和忙碌的人吃到热饭；谁想拿孩子和伤员换一份漂亮结论，我就拦着。: I want the injured and the busy to have hot meals. If anyone tries to trade children or the injured for a tidy conclusion, I will stop them.
